mapper.select: SELECT u.id, u.username, u.nickname, u.email, COALESCE(GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT r.role_code ORDER BY r.role_code SEPARATOR ','), '') AS roleCode, CASE u.status WHEN 1 THEN 'ENABLED' WHEN 2 THEN 'LOCKED' ELSE 'DISABLED' END AS status, u.updated_time AS updatedTime FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.status = 1 WHERE u.deleted = 0 GROUP BY u.id, u.username, u.nickname, u.email, u.status, u.updated_time ORDER BY u.updated_time DESC

SELECT u.id, u.username, u.nickname, u.email, COALESCE(GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT r.role_code ORDER BY r.role_code SEPARATOR ','), '') AS roleCode, CASE u.status WHEN 1 THEN 'ENABLED' WHEN 2 THEN 'LOCKED' ELSE 'DISABLED' END AS status, u.updated_time AS updatedTime FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.status = 1 WHERE u.id = #{id} AND u.deleted = 0 GROUP BY u.id, u.username, u.nickname, u.email, u.status, u.updated_time
SELECT id, username, password_hash AS passwordHash, status FROM sys_user WHERE username = #{username} AND deleted = 0
SELECT r.role_code FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status = 1

SELECT p.permission_code FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.status = 1 JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id = ur.role_id JOIN sys_permission p ON p.id = rp.permission_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND p.status = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user_role (user_id, role_id) SELECT #{userId}, r.id FROM sys_role r WHERE r.role_code = #{roleCode} AND r.status = 1 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role ur WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND ur.role_id = r.id )
